prompt: Za kafu iz džezve, zašto ne miješati snažno nakon dodavanja kahve?
solution0: Snažno miješanje je ključno jer se tako talog ravnomjerno rasporedi i u šolji daje puniji okus.
solution1: Da se talog ne razbudi previše i ne uzburka, što bi završilo u šoljici umjesto da se slegne.
gemini_translated0: For coffee from a džezva, why not stir vigorously after adding the coffee? Vigorous stirring is key because it distributes the grounds evenly and gives a fuller flavor in the cup.
gemini_translated1: For coffee from a džezva, why not stir vigorously after adding the coffee? So that the grounds don't get too "awakened" and agitated, which would end up in the cup instead of settling.

prompt: Prilikom pravljenja rakije u kazanu, zašto se prvijenac (prvijenac destilata) obično odvaja?
solution0: Sadrži više niskovrijednih i potencijalno štetnih spojeva (npr. metanola) pa se odbacuje ili koristi za tehn. svrhe.
solution1: Prvijenac je najkvalitetniji dio jer prvi nosi najviše čistog etanola i uvijek ga treba čuvati za piće.
gemini_translated0: When making rakija in a pot still, why is the prvijenac (the first distillate) usually separated? It contains more low-value and potentially harmful compounds (e.g., methanol), so it is discarded or used for technical purposes.
gemini_translated1: When making rakija in a kazan, why is the prvijenac (the first part of the distillate) usually separated? The prvijenac is the highest quality part because it is the first to carry the most pure ethanol and should always be kept for drinking.

prompt: Kuhate kahvu na logorskoj vatri u džezvi. Zašto se koristi hladna voda na početku?
solution0: Postupno zagrijavanje omogućava ravnomjernu ekstrakciju; ključanje odmah daje gorčinu i talog u šoljici.
solution1: Vrela voda odmah iznad vatre daje najbolju aromu jer kofein ostaje stabilan i ne prelazi u napitak.
gemini_translated0: You are making coffee on a campfire in a džezva. Why is cold water used at the beginning? Gradual heating allows for even extraction; boiling immediately creates bitterness and grounds in the cup.
gemini_translated1: You are making coffee on a campfire in a džezva. Why is cold water used at the beginning? Hot water directly over the fire gives the best aroma because the caffeine remains stable and does not transfer into the drink.

prompt: Ako prolijete rakiju po stolu, kako sigurno očistiti?
solution0: Obrisati krpom i provjetriti prostoriju, držeći podalje od otvorenog plamena.
solution1: Zaprljano mjesto osušiti fenom u blizini plamena jer toplota najbrže ispari alkohol.
gemini_translated0: If you spill rakiju on the table, how do you clean it safely? Wipe it with a cloth and ventilate the room, keeping it away from open flames.
gemini_translated1: If you spill rakija on the table, how do you safely clean it up? Dry the soiled spot with a hairdryer near a flame because heat makes alcohol evaporate the fastest.

prompt: Nana uči unuka kako se pravi prava bosanska kahva na šporetu. Nakon što voda u džezvi proključa i doda se mljevena kahva, šta treba uraditi prije nego što kahvu sipate u fildžane?
solution0: Ostaviti džezvu na vatri da kahva jako ključa još par minuta i odmah promiješati pa naliti u fildžane.
solution1: Skloniti džezvu s vatre i ostaviti da se talog kahve slegne nekoliko minuta prije sipanja.
gemini_translated0: Grandma is teaching her grandson how to make real Bosnian kahva on the stove. After the water in the džezva boils and the ground kahva is added, what should be done before you pour the kahva into the fildžani? Leave the džezva on the heat so the kahva boils hard for another couple of minutes and immediately stir, then pour it into the fildžani.
gemini_translated1: Grandma is teaching her grandson how to make real Bosnian kahva on the stove. After the water in the džezva boils and the ground kahva is added, what should be done before pouring the kahva into the fildžani? Remove the džezva from the heat and let the coffee grounds settle for a few minutes before pouring.

prompt: Zamijesili ste tijesto za pitu i ostavili da odstoji 15-ak minuta. Kako ga treba ostaviti dok odmara?
solution0: Ostaviti tijesto nepokriveno na zraku da se prosuši po površini dok ne dođe vrijeme za rad.
solution1: Prekriti tijesto kuhinjskom krpom ili folijom da zadrži vlagu i ostane meko.
gemini_translated0: You have kneaded the dough for *pitu* and left it to rest for about 15 minutes. How should it be left while it rests? Leave the dough uncovered in the air to dry on the surface until it's time to work with it.
gemini_translated1: You have kneaded the dough for pita and left it to rest for about 15 minutes. How should it be left while it rests? Cover the dough with a kitchen towel or foil to retain moisture and stay soft.

prompt: Stari bosanski kuhari savjetuju pripremu suhog graha unaprijed. Šta je preporučljivo uraditi sa suhim grahom prije kuhanja?
solution0: Odmah staviti suhi grah da se kuha bez prethodnog močenja, jer nema potrebe gubiti vrijeme.
solution1: Namočiti grah u vodi nekoliko sati ili preko noći da omekša i brže se skuha.
gemini_translated0: Old Bosnian cooks advise preparing dry beans in advance. What is it advisable to do with dry beans before cooking? Immediately put the dry beans to cook without prior soaking, because there is no need to waste time.
gemini_translated1: Old Bosnian cooks advise preparing dry beans in advance. What is recommended to do with dry beans before cooking? Soak the beans in water for several hours or overnight to soften and cook faster.

prompt: Prijatelji spremaju roštilj na ćumur u dvorištu. Kada je najbolje početi peći ćevape na roštilju?
solution0: Tek kada ugljen sasvim zagori i dobije pepelastu sivu boju bez plamena, jer tada pruža ravnomjernu jaku toplinu.
solution1: Odmah čim zapalite ugljen i još uvijek su vidljivi plamen i crni komadi, kako bi meso dobilo dim i okus.
gemini_translated0: Friends are preparing a charcoal barbecue in the backyard. When is the best time to start grilling ćevapi on the barbecue? Only when the charcoal is completely burned and has an ashy gray color with no flame, because then it provides even, strong heat.
gemini_translated1: Friends are preparing a charcoal barbecue in the yard. When is the best time to start grilling ćevapi on the barbecue? Right after you light the charcoal and the flames and black pieces are still visible, so the meat gets smoke and flavor.

prompt: Mlada domaćica prvi put razvlači jufku za burek. Kako bi tijesto ostalo čitavo i tanko, kako treba rukovati jufkom?
solution0: Posuti stol i tijesto brašnom te pažljivo rastezati jufku dlanovima postepeno preko cijelog stola.
solution1: Potezati jufku naglim pokretima i snažno je vući dok se ne istanji, ne mareći ako pukne.
gemini_translated0: A young housewife is stretching jufka for burek for the first time. In order for the dough to remain intact and thin, how should the jufka be handled? Flour the table and the dough and carefully stretch the jufka with your palms gradually over the entire table.
gemini_translated1: A young housewife is stretching *jufka* for *burek* for the first time. How should the *jufka* be handled so that the dough remains whole and thin? Pull the *jufka* with abrupt movements and tug it strongly until it thins, not caring if it tears.

prompt: U Bosni se često suše šljive za pekmez. Šta pomaže da se šljive ne zalijepe za pleh tokom pečenja?
solution0: Staviti šljive direktno na metalni pleh bez obloge, jer će sokovi stvoriti prirodnu neljepljivu površinu.
solution1: Obložiti pleh papirom za pečenje ili lagano nauljiti površinu prije raspoređivanja šljiva.
gemini_translated0: In Bosnia, plums are often dried for pekmez. What helps to prevent the plums from sticking to the baking sheet during baking? Place the plums directly on the metal baking sheet without a liner, as the juices will create a natural non-stick surface.
gemini_translated1: In Bosnia, plums are often dried for pekmez. What helps to prevent the plums from sticking to the baking sheet during baking? Line the baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly oil the surface before arranging the plums.

prompt: Pečenje somuna u pekari zahtijeva visoku temperaturu. Zašto pekari koriste kliznu lopatu i kratko vrijeme pečenja?
solution0: Brz unos i kratak boravak na visokoj temperaturi stvaraju džepove pare i karakterističnu koru.
solution1: Dugo pečenje na niskoj temperaturi razvija više džepova pare i mekšu koru somuna.
gemini_translated0: Baking somun in a bakery requires a high temperature. Why do bakers use a sliding peel and a short baking time? A quick insertion and a short stay at a high temperature create steam pockets and the characteristic crust.
gemini_translated1: Baking *somun* in a bakery requires a high temperature. Why do bakers use a sliding peel and a short baking time? A long bake at a low temperature develops more steam pockets and a softer *somun* crust.

prompt: Ako se u sred bureta kiselog kupusa pojavi plijesan na površini rasola, šta učiniti?
solution0: Promiješati sve snažno da se plijesan jednako rasporedi; kiseline će je neutralisati.
solution1: Ukloniti plijesan, oprati kamen i obruč, doliti rasol da listovi budu potopljeni.
gemini_translated0: If mold appears on the surface of the rasol in the middle of a barrel of kiseli kupus, what should you do? Stir everything vigorously so that the mold is evenly distributed; the acids will neutralize it.
gemini_translated1: If mold appears on the surface of the rasol in the middle of a barrel of kiseli kupus, what should be done? Remove the mold, wash the stone and the hoop, and add more rasol so that the leaves are submerged.

prompt: Porodica je skuhala svježi domaći ajvar i puni vruć ajvar u sterilne tegle. Kako postupiti da bi ajvar duže trajao?
solution0: Ostaviti tegle otvorene da se ajvar hladi na sobnoj temperaturi prije zatvaranja, kako ne bi došlo do kondenzacije.
solution1: Odmah zatvoriti tegle poklopcima i okrenuti ih naopako da se stvori vakum prilikom hlađenja.
gemini_translated0: The family cooked fresh homemade ajvar and is pouring the hot ajvar into sterile jars. What to do to make the ajvar last longer? Leave the jars open for the ajvar to cool at room temperature before closing, to prevent condensation.
gemini_translated1: The family cooked fresh homemade ajvar and is filling sterile jars with the hot ajvar. How to proceed so that the ajvar lasts longer? Immediately close the jars with lids and turn them upside down to create a vacuum as they cool.

prompt: Zašto se pri pravljenju hurmašica tijesto ne treba previše mijesiti nakon dodavanja brašna?
solution0: Pretjerano razvijanje glutena učiniće kolač žilavim umjesto prhkim.
solution1: Dugačko mijesenje čini kolač pahuljastim, što je cilj hurmašica.
gemini_translated0: Why, when making hurmašica, should the dough not be kneaded too much after adding the flour? Over-developing the gluten will make the pastry tough instead of crumbly.
gemini_translated1: Why, when making hurmašica, should the dough not be kneaded too much after adding the flour? Long kneading makes the cake fluffy, which is the goal of hurmašica.

prompt: Pri sušenju čilima (ćilima) nakon pranja, kako spriječiti deformacije i razvlačenje uzorka?
solution0: Sušiti položen ravno na vodoravnoj podlozi i povremeno okretati da se ravnomjerno osuši.
solution1: Objesiti ćilim za dva ugla da visi, jer će tako voda najbrže iscureti, bez uticaja na oblik.
gemini_translated0: When drying a kilim (ćilim) after washing, how to prevent deformation and stretching of the pattern? Dry it laid flat on a horizontal surface and turn it occasionally to ensure it dries evenly.
gemini_translated1: When drying a ćilim after washing, how to prevent deformation and stretching of the pattern? Hang the ćilim by two corners to let it hang, as the water will drain the fastest this way, without affecting its shape.

prompt: Na koritu Neretve često puše bura. Kako postaviti šator da odoli vjetru?
solution0: Postaviti vrata šatora direktno prema vjetru da se provjetrava i manje zateže platno.
solution1: Zabiti klinove pod uglom i okrenuti uža strana šatora prema vjetru, zategnuti konope.
gemini_translated0: The bura often blows in the Neretva river valley. How to pitch a tent to withstand the wind? Position the tent door directly towards the wind so that it ventilates and puts less strain on the canvas.
gemini_translated1: In the Neretva river valley, the bura often blows. How to set up a tent to withstand the wind? Hammer the stakes in at an angle and turn the narrow side of the tent towards the wind, tighten the ropes.

prompt: Napravili ste promaju otvaranjem više prozora, i vrata soba počinju snažno lupati od strujanja zraka. Šta treba učiniti?
solution0: Ništa, promaja neće oštetiti vrata, samo pustite da se zrak slobodno kreće, lupanje je bezopasno.
solution1: Osigurati vrata klinom ili zatvoriti neke prozore kako bi se smanjio propuh i spriječilo lupanje.
gemini_translated0: You have created a *promaja* by opening multiple windows, and the room doors are starting to slam hard from the air current. What should be done? Nothing, the *promaja* will not damage the doors, just let the air move freely, the slamming is harmless.
gemini_translated1: You've created a draft by opening multiple windows, and the room doors are starting to slam shut from the air current. What should be done? Secure the doors with a wedge or close some windows to reduce the draft and prevent the slamming.

prompt: Na narodnom veselju svira kolo (tradicionalna igra). Kako ćete se priključiti kolu ako ne znate korake?
solution0: Skočiti unutra i kretati se nasumično kako vas muzika nosi, mašući rukama i nogama bez reda.
solution1: Uhvatiti se za ruke s drugima u kolu i pratiti ritam i korake susjeda, pomičući se u krug kao i ostali.
gemini_translated0: At the folk festival, the music for a kolo (a traditional dance) is playing. How will you join the kolo if you don't know the steps? Jump inside and move randomly as the music carries you, waving your arms and legs without order.
gemini_translated1: At the folk festival, they are playing the *kolo* (a traditional dance). How will you join the *kolo* if you don't know the steps? Join hands with others in the *kolo* and follow the rhythm and the steps of your neighbors, moving in a circle like the others.

prompt: U tradicionalnoj peći na drva (šporet), zašto se pepelom ponekad zadržava žar preko noći?
solution0: Pepeo brzo gasi žar jer povećava temperaturu pa gorivo izgori brže.
solution1: Pepeo usporava dotok zraka i čuva žar, olakšavajući jutarnje loženje.
gemini_translated0: In a traditional wood-burning stove (šporet), why are embers sometimes preserved overnight with ash? Ash quickly extinguishes embers because it increases the temperature, so the fuel burns out faster.
gemini_translated1: In a traditional wood-burning stove (šporet), why are embers sometimes kept overnight with ash? The ash slows down the airflow and preserves the embers, making it easier to start the fire in the morning.

prompt: Uz fildžan bosanske kahve, stariji ljudi često uzimaju kocku šećera. Kako se tradicionalno konzumira šećer uz kahvu?
solution0: Ubaci se cijela kocka šećera u kahvu i promiješa da se što prije otopi.
solution1: Kocka šećera se malo umoči u kahvu pa odgrize zubima i polako otapa u ustima dok pijete kahvu.
gemini_translated0: With a *fildžan* of Bosnian *kahva*, older people often take a sugar cube. How is sugar traditionally consumed with *kahva*? A whole sugar cube is put into the *kahva* and stirred so that it dissolves as quickly as possible.
gemini_translated1: With a fildžan of Bosnian coffee, older people often take a sugar cube. How is sugar traditionally consumed with coffee? The sugar cube is dipped a little into the coffee, then bitten off with the teeth and slowly dissolved in the mouth while drinking the coffee.

prompt: Planirate praviti sarmu od svježeg kupusa (ne ukiseljenog). Šta trebate uraditi s listovima kupusa prije motanja sarme?
solution0: Blanširati listove kratko u vrućoj vodi da omekšaju, kako bi se lakše motali.
solution1: Koristiti svježe sirove listove odmah, jer će se ionako skuhati tokom kuhanja sarme.
gemini_translated0: You are planning to make sarma from fresh cabbage (not soured). What should you do with the cabbage leaves before rolling the sarma? Briefly blanch the leaves in hot water to soften them, so they are easier to roll.
gemini_translated1: You are planning to make sarma from fresh cabbage (not soured). What do you need to do with the cabbage leaves before rolling the sarma? Use the fresh raw leaves immediately, as they will cook anyway during the cooking of the sarma.

prompt: Na skeli iznad Miljacke postavljate dasku kao privremeni mostić. Kako provjeriti nosivost?
solution0: Pretrčati preko što brže; brzina smanjuje opterećenje pa je manja šansa loma.
solution1: Postepeno opteretiti i osloniti na čvrste tačke s obje strane, izbjegavati klizave ili trule dijelove.
gemini_translated0: On the scaffolding above the Miljacka, you are placing a plank as a temporary small bridge. How to check its load-bearing capacity? Run across it as fast as possible; speed reduces the load, so there is less chance of it breaking.
gemini_translated1: On the scaffolding above the Miljacka, you are placing a plank as a temporary footbridge. How to check its load-bearing capacity? Load it gradually and support it on solid points on both sides, avoid slippery or rotten parts.

prompt: Skuhali ste veliku šerpu vruće čorbe. Da li vruću hranu odmah treba staviti u frižider?
solution0: Ne, vruću hranu treba prvo prohladiti na sobnoj temperaturi (ali ne predugo) pa je tek onda staviti u frižider.
solution1: Da, treba vrelu šerpu odmah staviti u frižider da se hrana brže rashladi i ne kvari se.
gemini_translated0: You have cooked a big pot of hot čorba. Should hot food be put in the refrigerator immediately? No, hot food should first be cooled to room temperature (but not for too long) and only then put in the refrigerator.
gemini_translated1: You have cooked a large pot of hot čorba. Should hot food be put in the refrigerator immediately? Yes, you should put the hot pot in the refrigerator immediately so the food cools faster and does not spoil.

prompt: Mijesite tradicionalni somun (lepinju) sa kvascem za večeru. Šta trebate uraditi s tijestom prije pečenja?
solution0: Ostaviti tijesto na toplom da nadođe oko sat vremena kako bi se udvostručio volumen prije pečenja.
solution1: Odmah oblikovati somune od svježe zamiješenog tijesta i staviti ih da se peku bez čekanja.
gemini_translated0: Knead the traditional somun (lepinja) with yeast for dinner. What do you need to do with the dough before baking? Leave the dough in a warm place to rise for about an hour so that it doubles in volume before baking.
gemini_translated1: Knead the traditional somun (lepinja) with yeast for dinner. What should you do with the dough before baking? Immediately shape the somuni from the freshly kneaded dough and put them to bake without waiting.

prompt: U tradiciji spremanja pita, zašto se stolnjak koristi kod motanja jufke?
solution0: Pomaže da se jufka lakše rola i prenese u tepsiju bez pucanja, klizeći po tkanini.
solution1: Stolnjak je samo ukras; otežava motanje jer tkanina hvata i trga jufku tokom rada.
gemini_translated0: In the tradition of preparing pita, why is a tablecloth used when rolling jufka? It helps the jufka roll more easily and be transferred into the tepsija without tearing, by sliding on the fabric.
gemini_translated1: In the tradition of preparing pita, why is a tablecloth used when rolling the jufka? The tablecloth is just for decoration; it makes the rolling more difficult because the fabric catches and tears the jufka during the process.

prompt: Prilikom pečenja ćevapa na roštilju, kako osigurati da se ravnomjerno ispeku a da ne zagore?
solution0: Često ih okretati sa svih strana kako bi se ujednačeno ispekli.
solution1: Ostaviti ih dugo na jednoj strani dok potpuno ne potamne pa ih tek onda okrenuti.
gemini_translated0: When grilling ćevapi on the grill, how do you ensure they cook evenly without burning? Turn them frequently on all sides so that they cook uniformly.
gemini_translated1: When grilling ćevapi on the grill, how do you ensure they cook evenly without burning? Leave them on one side for a long time until they are completely browned, and only then turn them.

prompt: Pravite pitu sirnicu u okrugloj tepsiji. Zašto podmazati tepsiju prije slaganja jufki?
solution0: Da se spriječi lijepljenje i da se donji sloj ravnomjerno zapeče i odvoji nakon pečenja.
solution1: Podmazivanje je nepotrebno; višak ulja u filu će uvijek spriječiti lijepljenje bez obzira na tepsiju.
gemini_translated0: Make the *pita sirnica* in a round *tepsija*. Why grease the *tepsija* before layering the *jufke*? To prevent sticking and so that the bottom layer bakes evenly and separates after baking.
gemini_translated1: You are making pita sirnicu in a round tepsija. Why grease the tepsija before layering the jufke? Greasing is unnecessary; the excess oil in the filling will always prevent sticking regardless of the tepsija.

prompt: Na Vlašiću pečete krompir u žaru. Kako ga pripremiti?
solution0: Zamotati u foliju i zakopati u žar, povremeno okretati radi ravnomjernog pečenja.
solution1: Staviti sirove kriške direktno na plamen da brže dobiju boju, pa će se naknadno ispeći iznutra.
gemini_translated0: On Vlašić, you roast potatoes in the embers. How to prepare them? Wrap them in foil and bury them in the embers, turning occasionally for even roasting.
gemini_translated1: On Vlašić, you are roasting potatoes in the embers. How to prepare them? Place raw slices directly on the flame so they get color faster, and then they will cook through on the inside.

prompt: Pržite tradicionalne uštipke od dizanog tijesta. Kako osigurati da uštipci budu hrskavi izvana a ne upiju previše ulja?
solution0: Staviti komade tijesta u mlako ulje i polako zagrijavati zajedno s uljem da bi se uštipci ravnomjerno skuhali.
solution1: Ulje zagrijati dobro prije prženja i održavati odgovarajuću temperaturu, kako bi se tijesto odmah zapeklo.
gemini_translated0: Fry traditional *uštipci* from leavened dough. How to ensure the *uštipci* are crispy on the outside and don't absorb too much oil? Place the pieces of dough in lukewarm oil and slowly heat them together with the oil so that the *uštipci* cook evenly.
gemini_translated1: Fry traditional uštipci made from leavened dough. How to ensure the uštipci are crispy on the outside and don't absorb too much oil? Heat the oil well before frying and maintain the proper temperature, so that the dough sears immediately.

prompt: Planinarite područjem gdje stoje znakovi upozorenja na mine zaostale iz rata. Kako ćete postupiti?
solution0: Odmah se vratiti nazad istim putem kojim ste došli i obavijestiti nadležne službe o lokaciji upozorenja.
solution1: Nastaviti oprezno dalje mimo označenih staza, pazeći da ne stanete direktno na ništa sumnjivo.
gemini_translated0: You are hiking in an area where there are warning signs for mines left over from the war. How will you proceed? Immediately return the same way you came and inform the competent authorities about the location of the warning.
gemini_translated1: You are hiking in an area where there are warning signs for mines left over from the war. What will you do? Continue cautiously past the marked trails, being careful not to step directly on anything suspicious.

prompt: Na pijaci kupujete sir iz mješinice. Kako ga čuvati kod kuće?
solution0: Na kuhinjskom pultu na sobnoj temperaturi, jer je slanost dovoljna da ga očuva sedmicama.
solution1: U frižideru, umotanom u papir ili posudi, uz povremenu promjenu vode ako je slan.
gemini_translated0: You are buying *sir iz mješinice* at the market. How to store it at home? On the kitchen counter at room temperature, because the saltiness is enough to preserve it for weeks.
gemini_translated1: You are buying *sir iz mješinice* at the market. How to store it at home? In the refrigerator, wrapped in paper or in a container, changing the water occasionally if it is salty.

prompt: Pripremate kiseli kupus u bačvi. Zašto se kamen (pretežak) stavlja na listove iznad soli i vode?
solution0: Samo da bi bačva izgledala tradicionalno; nema praktičnu funkciju jer rasol i bez toga savršeno djeluje.
solution1: Da drži listove potopljenim ispod rasola, sprečavajući kvarenje u dodiru s vazduhom.
gemini_translated0: You are preparing fermented cabbage in a barrel. Why is a (very heavy) stone placed on the leaves above the salt and water? Just to make the barrel look traditional; it has no practical function because the brine works perfectly even without it.
gemini_translated1: You are preparing kiseli kupus in a barrel. Why is a stone (very heavy) placed on the leaves above the salt and water? To keep the leaves submerged under the brine, preventing spoilage from contact with the air.

prompt: U domaćinstvu pravite pekmez. Zašto se pjena skida tokom kuhanja voća?
solution0: Skidanjem pjene gubi se aroma; bolje je pjenom poklopiti da zadrži miris u šerpi.
solution1: Pjena sadrži nečistoće i zrak; uklanjanjem se dobija čišći i stabilniji pekmez.
gemini_translated0: You are making pekmez at home. Why is the foam skimmed off while the fruit is cooking? Skimming the foam leads to a loss of aroma; it is better to cover with the foam to keep the scent in the pot.
